Source: A 15-year-old girl presents to the clinic due to concern that she may be pregnant.
The patient asks for an emergency contraceptive pill and would prefer that her parents not be notified about her visit.
She has had regular menses since menarche, and her last menstrual period ended 8 days ago.
She had unprotected sexual intercourse earlier that morning and requests emergency contraception.
A urine pregnancy test is negative.
Her temperature is 98.6°F (37°C), blood pressure is 114/71 mmHg, pulse is 81/min, and respirations are 12/min.
She has no significant medical history.
